elements.evidence: "HDI shall defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates"

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies against third-party claims and resulting damages/costs
elements.evidence: "against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees)"

elements.element: Trigger: IP infringement by services or deliverables
elements.evidence: "the services performed by HDI hereunder or the Site and other deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right"

elements.element: Trigger: data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: "(c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Content caused by HDI"

elements.element: Trigger: gross negligence or wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "(d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct"
"shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim"
"shall permit the indemnifying Party to control the defense of the claim"

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content
elements.evidence: "the Content or Marks furnished by the Company infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right"

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: "or out of the Company's breach of applicable law"

elements.element: Vendor IP indemnity with usual exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, specifications)
elements.evidence: No exclusions appear; clause states only "to the extent arising out of (a) any allegation that the services ... infringe"

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: No cap language in the inserted clause.

reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are satisfied: defence and indemnity for the Company and its affiliates, the four required triggers (IP infringement of services/deliverables, breach of law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access/disclosure of Content, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), and the notice/control/cooperation procedure.
The reciprocal Customer indemnity is confined to Content and Marks furnished by the Company and the Company's own breach of applicable law, matching the preferred limitation.
Fallback elements (exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, 3× super-cap) are absent, but the locked target is preferred and the two levels are separate bargains.

Insertion is a concise new clause for an entirely absent protection, adds no hold-harmless, extra indemnitees, Customer defence duty, or settlement mechanics, and leaves Section 9(b) and Section 10 untouched.
